title: A Hydrophobic Core Stabilizes the Residual Structure in the RRM2 Intermediate State of the ALS-linked Protein TDP-43.
authors: Mackness, Brian C; Morgan, Brittany R; Deveau, Laura M; Kathuria, Sagar V; Zitzewitz, Jill A; Massi, Francesca
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ALS相关TDP-43蛋白RRM2结构域折叠中间态的疏水核心稳定性，涉及RNA识别基序（RRM）的蛋白质-RNA互作背景，但核心是蛋白质折叠而非TF-DNA结合，且方法以MD模拟为主，与课题的TF-DNA互作建模相关性有限。
abstract: Folding intermediates mediate both protein folding and the misfolding and aggregation observed in human diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), and are prime targets for therapeutic interventions. In this study, we identified the core nucleus of structure for a folding intermediate in the second RNA recognition motif (RRM2) of the ALS-linked RNA-binding protein, TDP-43 (TAR DNA-binding protein-43), using a combination of experimental and computational approaches. Urea equilibrium unfolding studies revealed that the RRM2 intermediate state consists of collapsed residual secondary structure localized to the N-terminal half of RRM2, while the C-terminus is largely disordered. Steered molecular dynamics simulations and mutagenesis studies yielded key stabilizing hydrophobic contacts that, when mutated to alanine, severely disrupt the overall fold of RRM2. In combination, these findings suggest a role for this RRM intermediate in normal TDP-43 function as well as serving as a template for misfolding and aggregation through the low stability and non-native secondary structure.
abstract_zh: 折叠中间体既介导蛋白质折叠，也介导人类疾病（包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS)）中观察到的错误折叠和聚集，是治疗干预的主要靶点。在本研究中，我们结合实验和计算方法，鉴定了ALS相关RNA结合蛋白TDP-43（TAR DNA结合蛋白-43）第二个RNA识别基序 (RRM2) 中折叠中间体的结构核心。尿素平衡解折叠研究表明，RRM2中间态由位于RRM2 N端半部分的塌缩残余二级结构组成，而C端大部分无序。定向分子动力学模拟和诱变研究揭示了关键的稳定疏水接触，当这些接触突变为丙氨酸时，会严重破坏RRM2的整体折叠。综合这些发现，表明该RRM中间体在正常TDP-43功能中发挥作用，并通过低稳定性和非天然二级结构作为错误折叠和聚集的模板。
